input: Renew my first aid certification before it lapses

gold.taskTitle: Renew First Aid Certification Before It Lapses
gold.taskDescription: Renew an existing first aid certification by finding and completing the required course or recertification process before the current certification expires.

questions.title: What is the exact expiry date on your current certification?
questions.description: Understanding the deadline helps determine urgency and how much time is available to plan.

questions.title: Which certifying body issued your current certification?
questions.description: For example, Red Cross, St. John Ambulance, or a workplace-specific provider, as renewal must often match the original issuer.

questions.title: What level of first aid certification do you need to renew?
questions.description: For example, basic first aid, CPR only, standard first aid, or advanced first aid.

questions.title: Is this certification required for work, volunteering, or personal reasons?
questions.description: The purpose may determine which specific accreditation or course format is acceptable.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person course or an online recertification option?
questions.description: Some certifications allow blended or fully online renewal; others require hands-on in-person assessment.

questions.title: What city or region are you located in for finding local courses?
questions.description: Location determines which training providers and course schedules are realistically accessible.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for the recertification course fee?
questions.description: Course costs vary widely by provider and level; knowing a budget helps narrow down the best options.
